selection.rule: First passing integer at or above the 160-row exposure lower bound; always compare 200.

generator.seedDerivation: baseSeed xor imul(count, 0x9e3779b1) xor splitSeed xor imul(restart + 1, 0x85ebca6b)

selectedDesignSearch.method: fixed-seed quota-preserving two-row swaps with split isolation

generator.serialization: Canonical compact UTF-8 JSON for SHA-256; pretty JSON uses two spaces and one final newline

variable.name: Channel
variable.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card.

variable.name: Ley Step
variable.text: Move 1 space. Gain 1 mana. Gain 1 additional mana if you are at Far range after moving.

variable.name: Attune
variable.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 additional mana for each other copy of Attune you played this turn.

variable.name: Prism
variable.text: Gain 2 mana. Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

variable.name: Arc Bolt
variable.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 4 damage at any range.

variable.name: Fireball
variable.text: Spend 2 mana. Deal 8 damage at any range.

variable.name: Starfire
variable.text: Spend 3 mana. Deal 12 damage at any range.

variable.name: Discharge
variable.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each mana you have. Lose all mana.

variable.name: Cascade
variable.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 4 damage at any range. Deal 2 additional damage for each other spell you played this turn.

variable.name: Overload
variable.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each mana you spent this turn.

variable.name: Feint
variable.text: At Close range, draw 1 card. Each Close-range attack you make this turn deals 1 additional damage.

variable.name: Jab
variable.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Draw 1 card.

variable.name: Strike
variable.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage.

variable.name: Drive
variable.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage. Then move both fighters 1 space so they remain Close. If a wall blocks the move, neither fighter moves and the attack deals 2 additional damage.

variable.name: Heavy Blow
variable.text: At Close range, deal 6 damage.

variable.name: Opening Strike
variable.text: At Close range, deal 4 damage if this is the first card you played this turn. Otherwise deal 1 damage.

variable.name: Rally
variable.text: At Close range, deal 1 damage. Deal 1 additional damage for each other copy of Rally you played this turn.

variable.name: Bull Rush
variable.text: At Close range, discard 1 Melee card: deal 5 damage.

variable.name: Flurry
variable.text: At Close range, deal 1 damage for each other Tactical Action played this turn.

variable.name: Aim
variable.text: At Near or Far range, draw 1 card. Add 2 damage to the next ranged attack you make this turn.

variable.name: Peppering Shot
variable.text: At Near or Far range, deal 1 damage. Draw 1 card.

variable.name: Steady Shot
variable.text: At Near or Far range, deal 2 damage.

variable.name: Repelling Shot
variable.text: At Far range, deal 2 damage. At Near range, deal 1 damage. Move the opponent 1 space farther away. If they cannot move, move yourself 1 space farther away instead.

variable.name: Longshot
variable.text: At Near or Far range, deal damage equal to the distance between you and your opponent.

variable.name: Volley
variable.text: At Near range, deal 1 damage. At Far range, deal 4 damage.

variable.name: Salvage Shot
variable.text: At Near or Far range, discard 1 Ranged card: deal damage equal to its cost. Draw 1 card.

variable.name: Precision Shot
variable.text: At Near or Far range, deal 4 damage. Each other copy of Precision Shot you play this turn deals 2 damage instead.

variable.name: Footwork
variable.text: You may move 1 space. Draw 1 card.

variable.name: Stipend
variable.text: Draw 1 card. Provide 1 money.

variable.name: Reclaim
variable.text: Put 1 card from your discard pile into your hand. If your discard pile is empty, draw 1 card.

variable.name: Regroup
variable.text: Draw 2 cards. Discard 1 card.

variable.name: Adapt
variable.text: Draw 1 card. If your position changed this turn, draw 1 more.

variable.name: Muster
variable.text: Draw 2 cards.

variable.name: Regiment
variable.text: Draw 3 cards.

variable.name: Discipline
variable.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Deal 1 damage at any range.

variable.name: Cull
variable.text: Trash 1 or 2 cards from your hand.

variable.name: Sharpen
variable.text: Draw 1 card. You may trash 1 card from your hand.

variable.name: Reforge
variable.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.

variable.name: Scour
variable.text: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Draw 1 card for each card trashed.

variable.name: Improvise
variable.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each different Mana, Melee, or Ranged family you played this turn.

assumptions: Rows are independent random 10-card subsets sampled with replacement.
Union bounds are conservative and do not assume independent item events.
The deterministic suite is not a random-population sample.

provenance.reason: Measures slow baseline economy and search failure
